assets.name: hero
assets.prompt: Create an original wide illustration for a Japanese house-cleaning landing page. STYLE IS CRITICAL: simple Japanese explanatory manga like the reference: bold clean dark outlines, rounded expressive adult faces, flat colors with only modest cel shading, drawn backgrounds. Absolutely no photorealism, realistic anime rendering, 3D, glossy skin or photographic textures. The reference is ONLY a style guide, do not copy its characters, content or layout. Original friendly woman in her 30s with short chestnut bob hair, cream cardigan and pale blue shirt talks to a polite professional male cleaner in his 30s with short black hair, navy polo, light grey work trousers and no logos. They stand in a tidy bright living room, looking at each other while the cleaner explains a simple checklist on a clipboard. Visible full upper bodies and enough room context: couch, window, wall mounted air conditioner, protected floor and neatly arranged cleaning bag. Eye level, welcoming calm scene, medium wide composition, landscape 3:2, blue/navy/white palette with warm natural accents. No text, no speech bubbles, no branding, no decorative badges. This should look like a hand-drawn commercial explainer manga illustration, with unmistakably simplified facial features and strong outlines.

assets.name: hygiene
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a NEW landscape 3:2 illustration for the hygiene section of a Japanese house-cleaning manga landing page. The supplied image is ONLY the canonical character and drawing-style reference, not an edit target. Show the exact same male cleaner: identical friendly face, eyes, eyebrows, short black side-swept hair, navy short-sleeved polo, light grey work trousers; NO glasses or facial hair. He is at a bright home washbasin washing his hands with soap, both hands anatomically natural under the running faucet. A neat cleaning caddy with clean folded cloths and a plain unbranded spray bottle sits on an adjacent counter, a partly open window is visible behind. No other people. Medium wide eye-level view: his head, upper body, basin, hands and surroundings fully visible, nothing important cropped. Strong clean dark outlines, simple flat cel colors, rounded expressive facial features, hand-drawn explanatory commercial manga identical to supplied image. Navy, pale blue and white with subdued warm accents. No photo realism, no realistic anime, no 3D render. No writing, logos, labels, bubbles, decorative badges, or watermark. This illustrates handwashing and clean equipment, without implying sterile or medically guaranteed conditions.

assets.name: farewell

Show exactly the same TWO PEOPLE, same face shapes, eyes, eyebrows, hair shapes, adult proportions and clothes: woman has short chestnut bob, cream cardigan, pale blue shirt and navy skirt; cleaner has short black side-swept hair, navy short-sleeved polo, light grey work trousers, NO glasses, NO facial hair. New scene: clean tidy entrance hallway of the woman's home after the work. The cleaner holds a neatly packed navy cleaning caddy at his side and gives a small respectful farewell bow, the woman standing opposite thanks him warmly with a gentle smile. Eye-level medium-wide view with both characters visible from head to at least knees, their faces large enough for recognition. Draw shoe cabinet, a pair of slippers and subtle potted plant; no other people. Match reference exactly: bold clean dark outlines, simple flat cel colors, friendly rounded expressive adults, drawn backgrounds. Blue/navy/white palette with subdued warm accents. No photographic realism, realistic anime, 3D, speech bubbles, writing, logos, stickers or watermark. This is the same recurring cleaner and customer at the end of their service story, not new actors.
